exams.about.heading.label: About heading
exams.about.heading.hint: The explainer below the exam cards

exams.about.p1.value: The AgilePM Foundation exam tests your understanding of the AgilePM framework: its eight principles, the team roles, the products produced through a project, and the agile project lifecycle. It is a closed-book, multiple-choice paper based on the AgilePM Handbook, and it is the entry-level AgilePM qualification. Passing Foundation is the prerequisite for the AgilePM Practitioner exam, which tests how well you can apply the framework to a real project scenario.
exams.about.p1.label: About, first paragraph
exams.about.p1.hint: The explainer below the exam cards

exams.about.p2.value: Our free AgilePM3 Foundation practice papers follow the Foundation format: 50 questions to complete in 40 minutes, with a pass mark of 25 out of 50 (50%). They are based on the latest version of the AgilePM Handbook. Sit a paper as a timed mock exam to rehearse the real thing, or switch to revision mode and work through the questions at your own pace with answers and explanations.
exams.about.p2.label: About, second paragraph
exams.about.p2.hint: The explainer below the exam cards

exams.prepare.heading.label: How to prepare heading
exams.prepare.heading.hint: The explainer below the exam cards

exams.prepare.steps.value:
Read the AgilePM Handbook and learn the eight principles, the roles, and the products.
Understand the agile project lifecycle and how the phases fit together.
Practise under timed conditions so the 40-minute limit feels comfortable.
Use revision mode to focus on the topics you find hardest, then re-sit a full paper.
exams.prepare.steps.label: How to prepare steps
exams.prepare.steps.hint: The explainer below the exam cards. One per line, add or remove lines freely

exams.faq.items.label: Questions and answers
exams.faq.items.hint: One per question people ask. They appear below the exam cards and are also given to search engines as the page’s questions and answers, so write what is true of your own papers. Leave it empty and the section disappears, heading and all.
